# `std::cli` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../stdlib/std/cli.lani#L6)

Layer: `std`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Declarative command-line parser with GNU getopt_long rules: short options and -abc clusters, unique-prefix long options, --opt=value and --opt value, attached optional values, -- and -, permuting or stop-at-operand order, operand counts, subcommands, repeated options in argument order, generated --help text and glibc-style error messages naming the bad argument. Native binaries from lcc agree with a Python model (checked against Python getopt on 4,051 cases) on 6,026 generated and fixed cases and 7 help texts; tgz and seq-diff use it.
